purpose: Disjoint complete motions in four CPU worker processes; unchanged SMPL-X/GMR/encoding algorithms
motion_partition: Greedy balance by declared frame count; each source belongs to exactly one worker; sequential frames within each motion
worker_affinity: All workers share the same fixed CPUset0-3, preserving original four-thread numerical kernels; aggregate execution cannot use CPUs outside this set
revision_reason: Same Torch/MKL4 and OpenBLAS1 numerical kernels; idle OpenMP helpers sleep rather than compete with concurrent GMR processes on four shared cores
